name: Al-'Adiyat · العاديات
en: And that within the breasts is obtained

name: Al-'Adiyat · العاديات
en: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted

name: Al-Qari'ah · القارعة
en: The Striking Calamity

name: Al-Qari'ah · القارعة
en: What is the Striking Calamity

name: Al-Qari'ah · القارعة
en: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity

name: Al-Qari'ah · القارعة
en: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed

name: Al-Qari'ah · القارعة
en: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up

name: Al-Qari'ah · القارعة
en: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds]

name: Al-Qari'ah · القارعة
en: He will be in a pleasant life

name: Al-Qari'ah · القارعة
en: But as for one whose scales are light

name: Al-Qari'ah · القارعة
en: His refuge will be an abyss

name: Al-Qari'ah · القارعة
en: And what can make you know what that is

name: Al-Qari'ah · القارعة
en: It is a Fire, intensely hot

name: At-Takathur · التكاثر
en: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you

name: At-Takathur · التكاثر
en: Until you visit the graveyards

name: At-Takathur · التكاثر
en: No! You are going to know

name: At-Takathur · التكاثر
en: Then no! You are going to know

name: At-Takathur · التكاثر
en: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty

name: At-Takathur · التكاثر
en: You will surely see the Hellfire

name: At-Takathur · التكاثر
en: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty

name: At-Takathur · التكاثر
en: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure
